title: Advanced Bond Valuation: Credit Spreads and the Yield Curve
subtitle: Price any bond off the spot curve plus a credit spread, and read what the curve and spreads are telling you
description: An advanced, India-first course on the two things a single yield to maturity hides: the term structure of interest rates and the credit spread. Built for experienced retail investors, active traders, and HNIs who can already price a bond and compute duration, and now want to bootstrap a zero-coupon curve from G-Sec prices, extract forward rates, read curve shapes and curve trades, decompose a corporate bond's spread into default, recovery, liquidity, and tax components, and value any bond cash flow by cash flow off the curve plus a spread. Uses FBIL and CCIL data, NSE and BSE corporate bond quotes, RBI Retail Direct, debt fund factsheets, and real Indian credit events including IL&FS, DHFL, and the 2020 credit risk fund episode, with every calculation worked in INR.
topics: Curve Trades and Key Rate Duration
whatYouLearn: Bootstrap a zero-coupon spot curve from G-Sec prices and explain why YTM is a blunt average that spot rates sharpen
Compute implied forward rates and read what the curve is pricing about future RBI repo decisions
Identify normal, flat, inverted, and humped curves and express a curve view using gilt, constant maturity, and target maturity funds
Measure exposure along the curve with key rate durations instead of one portfolio duration number
Choose between G-spread, I-spread, Z-spread, and OAS, and compute each for an Indian corporate bond
Back out the market-implied default probability from a spread and a recovery assumption
Read the AAA to BBB spread ladder, SDL and PSU spreads, and NBFC and perpetual bond spreads on NSE and BSE
Value a corporate bond cash flow by cash flow off the spot curve plus a spread, and stress it for rate, curve, and spread shocks together
